    FROM [SessionPayments] AS [s]
    INNER JOIN [ScheduledSessions] AS [s0] ON [s].[ScheduledSessionId] = [s0].[Id]
    WHERE [s].[StudentId] = @userId AND [s].[Status] = 2
    ORDER BY [s0].[ScheduledTime] DESC
) AS [s1]
INNER JOIN [Trainers] AS [t] ON [s1].[TrainerId0] = [t].[Id]
INNER JOIN [AspNetUsers] AS [a] ON [t].[UserId] = [a].[Id]
ORDER BY [s1].[ScheduledTime] DESC
